item.description: Bangalore-based solar module and cell manufacturing company Emmvee Photovoltaics, which has shifted most of its production towards TOPCon, says that the avenues for Mono-PERC technology have dwindled. item.title: Renewables Gain Momentum in Indian Textile Industry, Yet Challenges Persist: ICRA
item.description: A new report from ICRA ESG Ratings Limited shows a steady increase in renewable energy adoption by Indian textile companies, even as energy use per unit of revenue has risen. The findings are based on a review of 19 major textile firms, including Page Industries Ltd, Welspun Living Ltd, Arvind Ltd, and KPR Mill Ltd, from FY2023 to FY2025. item.title: Waaree Energies Expands Manufacturing Capacity with Additional 1.5 GW at Samakhiali Facility
item.description: Indian solar module and cell manufactuter Waaree Energies has expanded its domestic production capacity by adding 1.5 GW of solar module manufacturing at its Samakhiali plant in Kutch, Gujarat. The expansion follows the commissioning of two high-efficiency module lines of 750 MW each at the same site, taking total new capacity added to 1.5 GW. item.title: Japan’s Sumitomo to Invest USD 1.3 Billion in Indian Renewable Projects
item.description: Sumitomo Corporation plans to deploy about USD 1.3 billion in India’s renewable energy sector, targeting fast-rising electricity demand from large industrial consumers. The capital will be channelled through a joint venture with domestic clean energy developer AMPIN Energy Transition. Under this partnership, the companies aim to develop renewable projects with a combined capacity of 2 gigawatts by the end of the financial year ending March 2028. item.title: Inox Wind Announces 102.3 MW Order From Aditya Birla Renewables
item.description: Inox Wind Limited (IWL), has announced that it has secured a 102.3 MW order from ABREL EPC Ltd., a subsidiary of Aditya Birla Renewables Limited (ABReL). This is the first order secured by Inox Wind from Aditya Birla Renewables, which is for the supply of IWL’s 3.3 MW turbines for the projects being developed by ABREL EPC Ltd. in Karnataka. item.title: Non-Compliant Wind Turbines at IAF Airbases Face Shutdown Threat
item.description: The Ministry of New and Renewable Energy (MNRE), in its latest order, said that all non-compliant wind turbines could soon face the threat of shutdown. This came to light after the Indian Air Force (IAF) approached the ministry, citing non-technical compliance issues in some projects located at IAF airbases. item.title: Jakson Claims To Set Up India’s First Hi-Tech Solar Panel Recycling Plant
item.description: Jakson Engineers Limited, part of India’s Jakson Group, has signed an agreement with a European technology provider to establish what it said would be the country’s first hi-tech photovoltaic (PV) module recycling facility, as India begins to address the growing challenge of end-of-life solar waste. The company said the plant will be capable of recycling around 300 megawatts of solar panels annually, equivalent to about 500,000 modules or 13,500 tonnes of material a year.
